businessMeaning: Expose approval-policy administration and manager delegation inside the HRIS information architecture by adapting the existing DWP Approval product contracts. HRIS supplies contextual routes and presentation only; dwp-approval-server remains the sole business and persistence owner.

provenExisting: The Approval product already owns policy catalog, policy publish, delegation list, delegation create and delegation revoke behavior and persistence.
The HRIS information architecture already reserves BASE:settings-workflow at /hr/settings/workflow and BASE:team-delegation at /hr/team/delegation.
The shared frontend approval clients and workspaces already implement reusable policy and delegation interaction patterns.
The cross-product authorization register already requires both APP.HCM and APP.APPROVALS product access plus exact read or command capability and duty bindings.
missingWork: Implement the default-off HRIS workflow-policy workspace at /hr/settings/workflow.
Implement the default-off HRIS manager delegation workspace at /hr/team/delegation.
Add thin HRIS adapters for SHARED-API-005, SHARED-API-006, SHARED-API-010, SHARED-API-011 and SHARED-API-012 without changing their owner semantics.
Bind loading, empty, unavailable, permission, stale-selection, mutation-pending and immutable receipt outcomes into the HRIS shell without a blank canvas.
reuseOnly: dwp-approval-server ApprovalAdminController policy catalog and publish endpoints
dwp-approval-server ApprovalController delegation list, create and revoke endpoints
libs/shared-utils approval-management-api for policy query and approval-api for policy publish plus delegation list, create and revoke
existing Approval policy and delegation models, presentation components, owner guards, receipts and persistence
existing HRIS information-architecture nodes and shell admission
noTouchOrRecount: Do not create an HRIS approval engine, workflow evaluator, delegation engine, approval receipt store or duplicate approval table.
Do not proxy, fork or reimplement the five SHARED API endpoints in Platform, People, Time, Payroll or Performance services.
Do not modify shared Approval business transitions or count existing Approval implementation as new SYS-003 business logic.
Do not modify generated product-authorization, OpenAPI, gateway, Auth or route catalogs under this packet.
Do not author Platform V332, Approval V59 or any other migration without a separately reviewed persistence-delta proof and a new exclusive lease.
Do not mutate historical registers or Batch01 evidence.

settingsWorkflow.primaryUser: HRIS configuration author or policy publisher
settingsWorkflow.operationalQuestion: Which Approval policies govern HRIS work and which approved version can be published without bypassing four-eyes controls?

teamDelegation.primaryUser: Line manager with an authorized delegation population
teamDelegation.operationalQuestion: Which approval duties are delegated for my authorized population, during which window, and can a governed create or revoke command be submitted?

experienceContract.scopeRule: Both APP.HCM and APP.APPROVALS access are required. Page, data and command decisions remain separate; a read decision never authorizes publish, create or revoke.

adapterRules: Preserve exact HTTP method, route, request and response shapes and owner-issued problem details.
Propagate the installed trusted request scope; never synthesize tenant, role, duty, population, purpose or decision headers.
Preserve owner idempotency, subject revision, policy version, delegation window and receipt semantics.
Abort superseded queries and invalidate only the exact policy or delegation query after a successful owner command.
Never transform a denied or unavailable command into a local optimistic success.

migration.separateGate: A reviewed persistence touch manifest and a new exclusive lease must precede any migration authoring.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: /hr/settings/workflow mounts a real HRIS workflow-policy workspace and invokes only SHARED-API-005 when its default-off feature and page/data decisions permit it.
An authorized policy publish invokes only SHARED-API-006 with the current policy/version context, owner-required idempotency and immutable receipt handling.
/hr/team/delegation mounts a real manager delegation workspace and invokes only SHARED-API-010 for the installed authorized population.
Delegation create and revoke invoke only SHARED-API-011 and SHARED-API-012 and preserve owner window, scope, subject revision, idempotency and receipt semantics.
Policy read and publish plus delegation read and manage capabilities are evaluated separately; read access never renders an enabled mutation without the exact command decision.
Missing APP.HCM or APP.APPROVALS access, wrong tenant, role plane, duty, population, purpose, revision or SoD fails closed before owner query or mutation and does not leak resource existence.
Adapters preserve existing Approval request and response contracts and do not add a Platform proxy, HRIS business transition or second command receipt.
Loading, empty, unavailable, partial, permission, stale-selection, command-pending, success-receipt and owner-rejection states remain explicit and never render a blank canvas.
Route, tab and focus state are URL-addressable and preserve an authorized selection across refresh; unauthorized focus identifiers are removed without disclosure.
Both workspaces pass keyboard and screen-reader operation plus 1440, 1280, 390, 320 and 200-percent zoom checks in light, dark, high-contrast and reduced-motion modes.
Feature OFF or an unenrolled tenant mounts no policy or delegation owner query runtime and exposes no enabled command.

Changed-path evidence proves no Approval engine, owner controller, owner persistence, migration, product-authorization, OpenAPI, Auth, Gateway, route catalog or historical register was modified or recounted.

frontendTargets: new workflow-policy adapter and workspace tests under apps/dwp/src/features/hris/administration/workflow
new delegation adapter and workspace tests under apps/dwp/src/features/hris/team/delegation
conditionalReuseRegressionTargets: libs/shared-utils/src/api/approval-management-api.test.ts only if the policy-query client changes under a separately issued successor
the smallest approval-api policy-publish or delegation test only if that shared client changes under a separately issued successor
dwp-approval-server ApprovalDelegationControllerTest and ApprovalServiceTest only if separately authorized backend adapter work becomes necessary

required: frontend module branch SHA and tree
twelve acceptance results with source or targeted-test evidence
five SHARED API adapter route/method seals
cross-product entitlement, duty, population, purpose, revision and SoD negative evidence
changed-path and no-recount manifest proving no backend or migration delta
